reserveReview.rationale: The first-party FPI collateral endpoint was re-read on 2026-08-08 (block 25711761). Ferry/liability entries (FPI tokens locked in FraxFerry) were excluded because they represent bridged supply rather than reserve assets. The remaining reserve positions — Ethereum and Fraxtal comptroller FRAX balances plus the FPI Controller FRAX balance, staked Convex FPI/FRAX LP, Fraxswap V2 FRAX/FPIS, and a negligible FXS dust balance — were normalized to four classified rows. Each LP, governance-token, market, and upstream-stablecoin failure domain is retained rather than folding the portfolio into a single FRAX claim.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All positive reserve positions returned by the first-party endpoint are identified and classified; pool composition, unwind depth, and governance-token market risks remain structured within the classified exposures.
